$comment: Capability -> adapter registry. The orchestrator NEVER calls a provider directly; it calls the adapter registered here for a capability. Swap a provider by changing `default` (or run `/video-factory:setup`). Each adapter satisfies the matching contract in CONTRACTS.md. `tier` documents what's needed: 'core' = no key; 'plugin' = needs a key/credential.

elevenlabs.est_note: Flash / Turbo row: $0.04 per 1K characters. Billed per character; converted at 15 characters per second of speech (an assumption, about 150 words a minute).

say.note: macOS built-in `say`; no word timings (captions fall back to estimated).

openai-whisper.note: Whisper-1 with WORD-level timestamps. VERIFIED. Powers caption recovery + scripts/extract-voice.mjs (forced-align a real recording so a speaker's actual voice can voice a scene instead of TTS). OpenAI removes whisper-1 on 2027-02-26 and its replacement gpt-transcribe returns no word timestamps, so captions need another word-timing source before then.

gemini-imagen.note: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image (`gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`) via the Gemini Interactions API (direct). 1K output.
gemini-imagen.est_note: 1K image output: 1,120 tokens at $30.00 per 1M image-output tokens.

gpt-image.note: OpenAI gpt-image-2. VERIFIED. Strong prompt adherence + text-in-image. OpenAI removes gpt-image-2 on 2027-02-10; its named replacements are gpt-image-2.6-sunburst and gpt-image-2.6-flare (set image.openai_model to try one; not yet run through this adapter).
gpt-image.est_note: Highest published per-image price (high quality, 1024x1024). The adapter sends no quality, so the real price is between $0.005 (low) and this.

ideogram.note: Use when the image must contain readable text.

omni.note: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (`gemini-omni-1.2-flash`) via the Interactions API. 3–15 s, native audio, 720p default.
omni.est_note: 720p video output: 5,792 tokens per second at $12.00 per 1M video-output tokens, approximately $0.07 per second.

veo.note: SHUT DOWN 2026-10-22. Veo 3.1 Preview is no longer available; use `omni`.

kling.note: Kling official single-key API (direct). Auth+submit+error VERIFIED; needs account credits to produce.
kling.est_note: No estimate. https://kling.ai/dev/pricing showed no figures on 2026-11-12; resellers quote $0.21 per 5 s clip for kling-v2-6 std, which is not Kling's own list price.

fal-veo.note: No adapter file yet. fal lists fal-ai/veo3.1/fast for removal on 2026-11-17 (https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/veo3.1/fast, read 2026-11-12).

elevenlabs-sfx.est_note: Sound effects: $0.12 per minute. Per call at the adapter's 22 s maximum, so an upper bound for one effect.

freesound.note: CC library; free; saves generation credits.

sync.note: Lip-sync onto real footage of you.

remotion.note: Render natively per-aspect in the compositor (no reframe step).
React+SVG compositor via Remotion renderer (production core).

hyperframes.note: Experimental fast deterministic HTML5+GSAP render via HyperFrames.

ffmpeg-lut.note: Pre-arranged looks (cinematic/warm-doc/punchy-social/noir) via ffmpeg filter chains or .cube LUTs. Headless, no DaVinci.

davinci.note: DEFERRED (see docs/ROADMAP.md). Scripts the Resolve API to apply a PowerGrade preset + AI ops (Super Scale, Magic Mask, noise, HDR) to ONE clean master on a dedicated grading box. Semi-automated, NOT headless/cloud; runs under a watchdog (modal-dialog risk).
